entries.note: The share of a population with access to electricity, as a percentage.
The under-five mortality rate: the probability that a child born alive dies before reaching age five, expressed per live birth.
Personal remittances received from abroad, as a share of gross domestic product.
Gross domestic product at current prices, in US dollars, as the World Bank series and the IMF World Economic Outlook series report it.
The maternal mortality ratio: maternal deaths per 100,000 live births, as the SDG Global Database and UNICEF publish the same inter-agency estimates.
The adolescent birth rate: live births per 1,000 women aged 15 to 19, as the SDG Global Database and UNICEF publish it.
HIV incidence: new HIV infections per 1,000 uninfected population, as the SDG Global Database and UNAIDS publish it.
HIV incidence among women: new HIV infections per 1,000 uninfected women, as the SDG Global Database and UNAIDS publish it.
The prevalence rate of bribery: the share of people who paid a bribe to a public official, as the SDG Global Database and UNODC publish it.
Malaria incidence per 1,000 population at risk, as the SDG Global Database and WHO publish it.
